text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Under Harbor Credit Union's Privacy Notice (Rev. 01/2026), once we receive your request to limit sharing, your opt-out takes effect within 30 days, and it stays in effect until you tell us otherwise. Note: if you're a new member, we may begin sharing your information 30 days from the date the notice was sent. You can ask to limit sharing at any time by calling 1-800-4-HARBOR (option 6), visiting a branch, or using the \"Privacy Choices\" page in online banking.","cited_chunk_ids":["privacy_notice::layout::B_structure::0004"],"reason":"The Privacy Notice passage states the opt-out takes effect within 30 days of receipt of the request."}
